scope: Faithful finite-algebra identities over an explicit commutative quotient ring,including nilpotents. Inverse/curve hypotheses explicit;actual fields,divisors,proper curve maps,Picard and global degree geometry remain written.
statement: theorem cleared_fibre_factorization {K : Type} [CommRing K] (f m n q a b x y : K) (hcover : f*m^2=n^3+a*n*q^4+b*q^6) (hpoint : y^2=x^3+a*x+b) : f*m^2-y^2*q^6 = (n-x*q^2)*(n^2+n*x*q^2+x^2*q^4+a*q^4)
